# Resume

### Summary

Driven by data and fueled by creativity. VP of Product & Growth at Malachyte, building AI personalization for retailers, after a decade running ecommerce, CRM and creative on the brand side. I'm often described as an _agent of change_ and _process ninja_ by executives and peers. I get bored if I'm not learning and sharing what I learn with others. I am always seeking to develop better processes to help my teams do things bigger, better, and faster.

### VP of Product & Growth

Malachyte - Behavioral Intelligence and AI Personalization for Retail

#### April 2026 to Present

Lead product and growth for an AI personalization platform built for retailers. Started as a consultant in August 2025 and moved full-time in April 2026. I bring the brand-side buyer's view into the roadmap, because I spent a decade being the customer.

### Co-Founder & CEO

SwapTheLens - AI Product Photography

#### 2025 to Present

Built an AI product photography platform from the workflow I ran at FUN.com. One sample in, unlimited on-model and lifestyle images out.

### Director of Creative Services and Website

FUN.com - North Mankato, MN

#### July 2016 to April 2026

Direct strategy and development for the following departments: Website Experience (UX/CRO/Merch), CRM Marketing, Video and Photo production, Social Media, Copywriting, and Graphic Design.

**Key Accomplishments:**

- [**TikTok Case Study**](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en/inspiration) on brand due to leading revenue in vertical for the month of October. Results include 10x ROAS, 4.5k% increase in site visits yoy and a 2.5k% increase in purchases yoy.

- **Lead project** [**Halloween.com**](https://halloween.com/) **:** brand creation to standing up a fully operational and optimized site in 6 weeks

- **AI integration** across teams leading to 30%+ gain in copy efficiency while ensuring SEO viability through testing

- Led an **AI-first workflow** for a four-person creative photo team: projected 1,823 hours (29.5%) back per year and a nearly 60% cut to the production budget line.

- Built the HalloweenCostumes.com **Design Program** (designprogram.halloweencostumes.com) from scratch with AI assist on Firebase and GitHub, as a non-programmer: a customer design contest with Meta and Google social logins, public voting, and a custom admin side to manage entries.

- Spearheaded the **creation of Brand Guides, Personas, and NPS tracking** for all brands

- Developed **Capacity tracking** for teams that was adopted company-wide.

- Developed **labor costing analysis** from product development through launch to drive process improvements leading to a 6.2% decrease in time spent per item with first iteration

- **Loyalty Program:** Creation and dev implementation of the program leading to a 10.29% increased Repeat Rate during peak month for HalloweenCostumes.com and 14.42% for FUN.com in 2021 with continued growth YOY

- Started and scaled **paid licensor marketing partnerships** for major brands like Disney and Hasbro. Set strategy and ensured execution driving consistent YOY increases in revenue. Ex: year 1, +83% YOY. year 2, +76% YOY

- Justification and ownership of multiple software development projects annually: including UGC on-site, Category page ranking and positioning tool, recommendations engine integration, ESP transitions, and SMS channel implementation


**General responsibilities include:**

- "GM" of websites

- Own CX and NPS and drive company-wide changes to support improvements

- Creative direction for video content and imagery for all brands

- CRM Marketing and Social Media channel sales forecasting, budgeting, and P&L ownership

- Create and improve processes and workflows for my teams

- Pipeline and leadership development

- Company-wide project ownership as needed


### Co-Founder

[Type A Unhinged](https://typeaunhinged.com/)

#### January 2025 to present

Podcast and consulting company I co-founded with Nate Hewett. We host conversations with retail and brand leaders about AI, ecommerce and marketing, and we consult with startups and SMBs on AI integration, creative operations, and all things marketing.

**Core Responsibilities:**

- Co-host the Type A Unhinged podcast, interviewing retail and brand leaders on AI, ecommerce and marketing as well as other interesting folks with stories we can all learn from

- Lead AI integration and change management engagements, from picking the right tools to getting teams to actually use them

- Advise on creative operations, CRM and email strategy, and scaling processes so teams can go bigger, better and faster

- Build the brand and audience across the podcast, LinkedIn and speaking


### E-commerce & CRM Strategy Contractor

Pure Romance, OH

#### March 2024 to July 2025

As a Consultant, I specialized in enhancing website user experience and CRM marketing strategies for Pure Romance on a contract basis. My role involved optimizing digital touchpoints across the website and CRM channels including email and SMS.

**Core Responsibilities:**

- Leveraged data analytics to track website and CRM performance, providing actionable insights for strategic decision-making

- Identifying AB tests to drive revenue, and increase CRM subscriber lists while improving COS (cost of sale)

- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align marketing efforts with overall business objectives

- Optimized website user experience, improving customer journey and engagement

- Enhanced CRM marketing strategies across email and SMS channels, boosting customer retention


### Marketing Director

Carlson Craft, a Taylor Corp Company - North Mankato, MN

#### March 2014 to July 2016

Lead 3 teams totaling 18 direct reports: E-commerce development, design, and merchandising team and the advertising and communications team comprised of designers, copywriters, and coordinators.

**Core Responsibilities:**

- Marketing: creation, budgeting, and execution of a 12-month multi-channel marketing strategy for Carlson Craft and Hortense B. Hewitt brands. Set and achieve financial objectives for marketing plans and the overall brands.

- Branding: Communicate with and influence customer service, sales, IT, and production teams to create a unified customer and brand experience. Exhibiting and presenting at tradeshows and networking within the industry to promote brand.

- E-commerce Strategy & Planning: Drive the overall e-commerce strategy for the brand, including social media strategy, SEO, email, and any other e-commerce marketing activities to achieve brand goals.

- Financial: Understand, test and drive profitable sales and all associated metrics (traffic, downloads, conversions, AOV, etc).

- Site management and analytics: Monitor and manage key metrics, identifying opportunities for improvement.

- Product: Collaborate with Product Director on the strategic direction of website and app features and functionality, and user experience to achieve product, brand, and customer goals.

- CRM: B2B email marketing, social media, and marketing to drive traffic to channel partner sites.


### E-commerce and Brand Manager

Carlson Craft, a Taylor Corp Company - North Mankato, MN

#### September 2013 to March 2014

**Key Accomplishments**

- Successful execution of a new go-to-market tradeshow strategy for 2015 resulting in a 130% increase in new leads generated and a 320% increase in lead conversion

- Creation of the first Brand Style Guide for Carlson Craft. Development of branded communication templates for all channels

- Ideation and implementation of workflow processes utilizing SharePoint for all aspects of e-commerce workflow for phone reps and the data team supporting the sites. Analysis of data from this list to create key performance indicator (KPI) standards for the team

- Creation of a ticket system utilizing SharePoint for the advertising and communications team to streamline workflow and aid in internal transparency to project timelines


**Core Responsibilities**

- Lead a team of 4: Merchandising, Commerce Data and Development

- Commerce: drive and execute the overall e-commerce strategy, including social media, SEO, trigger emails, and UX development. Monitor and manage key metrics for the websites and analyze competition to identify opportunities for improvement


### Product and Marketing Manager

Navitor Folders, a Taylor Corp Company - North Mankato, MN

#### December 2008 to September 2013

**Key Accomplishments**

- Steered creation, branding, training, and launch of internal product idea generation and tracking site using SharePoint, which is still utilized to date

- Launch of the new packaging line; market research, product testing and development, costing and data structures, and pricing. Creating supporting marketing collateral both printed and web-based within budget. Training on the product line from customer service to production and marketing. Execution of go-to-market strategy

- Spearheaded a branding refresh for Accent, a brand operated by Navitor. Coordinating research and activities to evaluate and redefine brand position and promise. Providing direction to develop new logo and brand guidelines. Creating new marketing collateral, tradeshow presence, and social sites to support new branding


**Core Responsibilities**

- Creating and executing marketing plans; including printed materials and advertising and promotions, while maintaining the budget for the rolling calendar year

- In charge of merchandising catalogs, distribution, and pricing strategies by channel based on competitive landscape and market position

- Developing products and processes from inception to market launch, including internal staff training, for all channels

- Exhibiting at tradeshows and calling on top channel partners

- Managing a team of 3 and providing support and direction to other internal teams
